summary.content:
Today's selection covers 95 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 70 on Artificial Intelligence and 13 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Microsoft and OpenAI Workers Worry About ‘Largest Theft of Labor’ in History
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Microsoft AI CEO says AI threats are real, and Anthropic is making it worse
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, BBC Technology, TechCrunch, Ars Technica, The Verge and others
• **Fresh Content**: 52 articles published in the last 24 hours
